question: What status does the worshipper attain among gods and all beings?
premises: The worshipper becomes adored by the multitude of gods
The worshipper becomes approved among all beings
This status results from the prescribed worship
inference: The worshipper becomes adored by the gods and esteemed among all beings.
plain_english: Such a worshipper becomes adored by the hosts of gods and esteemed among all beings.
